71. (1) The meetings of the Zones SL Board shall be held
at least once in three month or as is required for the purpose
of exercising, performing and discharging the powers, duties
and functions conferred or imposed on, or assigned to the
Zones SL Board by this Part.
(2) The quorum for any meeting of the Zones SL Board
shall be five members.
(3)  A  meeting  of  the  Zones  SL  Board  may  be  held
either-

(a)
by  the  number  of  members  who  constitute  the
quorum being assembled at the place, date and time
appointed for the meeting; or

(b)
by means of audio-visual communication by which
all  members  participating  and  constituting  the
quorum  can  simultaneously  see  and  hear  each
participating member for the duration of the meeting.
(4)  All  questions  for  decision  at  any  meeting  of  the
Zones SL Board shall be decided by the vote of the majority
of members present and voting at such meeting. In the case
of an equality of votes, the Chairperson shall, in addition to
his vote, have a casting vote.
